parse_config_updates: parse command-line config update strings like foo.bar=17 into a dictionary and named configs list
format_usage_text: generate a docopt-compatible usage text for a sacred experiment with commands and options
format_options_usage: format a list of CLI options into a docopt Options section with flags and descriptions
format_command_usage: format a dictionary of commands into a docopt Commands section with names and docstrings
convert_cli_value: parse a command-line string value as a Python literal or fall back to a plain string
